user.title: Person Notify
user.description: Adds the `person_notify.send` action, which notifies every device linked to a person, and a diagnostic sensor per person listing its notifiers.

send.name: Send notification to person
send.description: Notifies all devices associated with the selected people (via their device trackers). Check sensor.<person>_notify_targets to see which devices will be notified.

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra data passed to mobile app notifications (actions, image, channel, ...). Ignored for plain notify entities.

get_targets.name: Get notify targets
get_targets.description: Returns the notifiers that would be used for the selected people.
